title: DominationAL Mod
description: Adds Custom Items, Dimensions, Biomes and Advancements!
body:
# 🌌 DominationAL Mod

DominationAL Mod is a content-packed Minecraft mod that expands your adventure with new biomes, ores, dimensions, tools, armor, weapons, boosters, progression systems, collectibles, and powerful endgame content.

---

# 🌍 Biome Distribution

Each biome is tied to specific dimensions, creating unique exploration paths across the world.

### 🌐 Overworld

* Uranium Biome

### 🧭 Domination Dimension

* Uranium Biome (also appears here)
* Mithril Biome
* Chromite Biome
* Domination Biome

### 🔥 Hell

* Cursed Biome

### ☁️ Heaven

* Divine Biome

### 🌑 Void Dimension (Shadow Dimension)

* Shadow Biome

### 🌪️ Zephyra Dimension

* Windstep Plains
* Tornado Plains
* Gale Forest
* Sky Ridges

---

# 🧭 Custom Dimensions

Travel across powerful and dangerous realms:

* Domination Dimension
* Heaven
* Hell
* Shadow (Void) Dimension
* Zephyra Dimension

The Zephyra Dimension is accessed using the **Zephyra Portal Igniter** and features floating terrain, wind-based environments, and unique resources.

---

# ⛏️ Ores & Progression System

Mine and progress through increasingly powerful materials:

* Uranium
* Mithril
* Chromite
* Sky Ore (Heaven)
* Shadow Ore (Hell)
* Void Ore (Shadow Dimension)
* Domination Ore
* Windstone Ore (Zephyra)
* Gale Crystal Ore (Zephyra)
* Void Core Ore (Zephyra)
* Zephyrite Ore (Zephyra)
* Prestiged Onyx Ore (Shadow Dimension)
* Ultimate Ingot

Each tier unlocks stronger gear and deeper progression paths.

---

# ⚔️ Tools, Weapons & Armor

Craft powerful equipment across all stages of progression:

### Domination Progression

* Upgraded Domination Armor
* Upgraded Domination Sword
* Super Domination Armor
* Super Domination Sword
* Ultimatum (strongest weapon)

### Advanced Equipment

* Almighty Armor
* Almighty Dagger
* Windstone Toolset
* Gale Crystal Armor Set
* Void Core Toolset
* Zephyrite Toolset
* Prestiged Onyx Toolset
* Prestiged Onyx Armor

---

# 🧱 Blocks & Building Materials

* Windstone Block
* Gale Crystal Block
* Void Core Block
* Zephyrite Block
* Prestiged Onyx Block
* Zephyra Wood Set (complete building set from Zephyra trees)

---

# 🏆 Ancient Progression System

Earn **Ancient Fragments** through advancements or by trading Coins with the Armorer.

* Ancient Fragments → Ancient Ingots
* Ancient Ingots → Almighty Armor

A progression system focused on exploration, combat, and achievement.

---

# 💰 Coin & Trading System

A full currency system used for progression:

* Copper Coin
* Iron Coin
* Gold Coin
* Diamond Coin

Coins can be traded with the Armorer to obtain Ancient Fragments.

---

# 🏆 Trophy Collection System

A full collector system for completionists:

* Bronze Trophy
* Silver Trophy
* Gold Trophy
* Ancient Trophy
* Diamond Trophy
* Emerald Trophy
* Netherite Trophy
* Ultimate Living Trophy

Includes a dedicated **Trophies Creative Tab** for organization.

---

# 💠 Boosters System

Boosters grant powerful progression-based abilities:

* Divine Booster
* Cursed Booster
* Domination Booster
* Sky Booster
* Shadow Booster
* Void Booster
* Ultimate Booster

Features:

* Equipable ability items
* Different effects depending on slot
* Leveling system for upgrades
* Booster Fusion system for combined abilities

---

# ✨ Abilities & Special Items

* Domination Effect
* Super Domination Effect
* Domination Upgrade Template
* Event Multitool
* Infinite Bread
* Admin Tool
* Admin Tool Lite (weaker, craftable version of the Admin Tool)
* Admin Block
* Zephyra Portal Igniter

---

# 📜 Custom Advancements

* Domination Dimension
* Domination Traveler
* First Player Damage
* Hell Advancement
* Heaven Advancement
* Every Dimension
* Zephyra Traveler

---

# 🌟 Ongoing Development

DominationAL Mod is primarily developed by a single developer and is continuously expanded with new content, progression systems, and endgame features.

---

## ⚙️ Required Dependency

* Just Enough Items (JEI)
